title: History Compression 001 — Replay Budget Ladder
scientific_scope: measure the minimum learner-visible historical calibration prompt budget needed to rediscover and safely train a sub-expert writable coordinate on the unchanged Granite MoE substrate

mutation.coordinate: aligned gate/up rows plus matching down-projection columns for one contiguous intermediate-channel group

new_task.train_template: History compression calibration H-{seed_mod}-{index:02d} resolves to
new_task.heldout_template: History compression calibration H-{seed_mod}-{index:02d} resolves to
new_task.target_token_selection: among candidates that tokenize to one token, choose the token with lowest mean frozen-base probability on new-task training prompts; ties choose candidate order

history.supervision: learner-visible historical calibration prompts plus frozen-base outputs; original Granite training data are not used
history.subset_rule: for each formal seed, sort all selection prompts by sha256('{seed}:{index}:{prompt}') ascending; each nonzero budget uses a nested prefix of that frozen order

compression_modes.selection: oracle score using new-task gradient energy, historical gradient importance, and routing specificity
compression_modes.training: target cross-entropy plus frozen-base full-logit KL on the learner-visible subset

compression_modes.selection: same oracle score computed only from the nested 8-prompt learner-visible subset
compression_modes.training: same objective and checkpoint rule using only the nested 8-prompt learner-visible subset

compression_modes.selection: same oracle score computed only from the nested 2-prompt learner-visible subset
compression_modes.training: same objective and checkpoint rule using only the nested 2-prompt learner-visible subset

compression_modes.selection: new-task gradient energy plus new-task routing coverage only; historical terms are exactly zero and no historical prompt or teacher output is learner-visible
compression_modes.training: target cross-entropy only; candidate selection uses new-task train gain only

selection.new_signal: mean squared gradient of new-task target NLL over frozen training batches
selection.history_importance: for nonzero modes, mean squared gradient of frozen-base top-1 NLL over only that mode's learner-visible history subset
selection.route_specificity: for nonzero modes, new-task expert top-k coverage minus learner-visible-history expert top-k coverage
selection.tie_break: higher score, then lower expert index, then lower group index

training.checkpoint_rule_nonzero_history: among evaluated nonzero candidates satisfying the mode-local learner-visible history KL budget, restore the checkpoint with maximum new-task train NLL gain; ties choose the earlier step
training.checkpoint_rule_zero_history: among evaluated nonzero candidates with positive new-task train NLL gain, restore the checkpoint with maximum gain; ties choose the earlier step
training.optimizer: manual masked SGD on one aligned intermediate group only

decision.per_mode_seed_pass: all gates pass for that mode and seed
decision.per_mode_support: at least 2 of 3 formal seeds pass for that mode
decision.positive_control_requirement: full_32 must be supported or the compression ladder is uninterpretable
decision.minimum_observed_supported_budget: smallest history_prompt_count among supported modes when the positive control is supported
decision.monotonicity: record whether support is monotone with increasing historical prompt budget; do not repair or relabel non-monotonic outcomes post hoc
not_claimed: general zero-replay continual learning even if zero_0 passes

logging.full_detail_policy: coordinate scores, training steps, metrics, and mutation data are durable files and must not be dumped wholesale to notebook stdout
